candidate_evidence.quote: SI-053 is a novel powder formulation containing temozolomide (TMZ), an alkylating chemotherapy agent

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Determination of plasma concentration of TMZ and its metabolite

role_evidence.quote: SI-053 will be applied intracranially (i.c.) into the cavity that is formed after tumor resection.

agents.drug_class_hint: temozolomide gel formulation for intracavitary (intracranial) application; alkylating agent

role_evidence.quote: SoC consists of maximal safe resection followed by radiation therapy (RT) with concomitant TMZ and adjuvant chemotherapy with TMZ.

coder_notes: SI-053 is a new formulation and new route (intracavitary gel) of temozolomide, an established GBM therapy, so it is established_therapy_experiment (rule 6) and not a candidate. Lomustine (CeTeG protocol for MGMT-methylated tumours) is mentioned only as an investigator-preferred option, not given to every patient, so it is not listed. MGMT is mentioned only as a basis for the investigator's choice of standard regimen, not as an entry requirement or planned biomarker, so no biomarker row. PK is plasma-only.
